summary: Tested the role fix: UTENTE (event_user, personal link + verification code), the Organizzatore/Amministratore labels, Super Admin disable/reactivate, and a regression check. Backend: 28/28 pytest pass (tests/test_event_users_roles.py). The Utente gets 401/403 on every back-end API tested, including POST /events and /auth/complete-organization. GET /my-event-access returns only the active assigned event, with its incarico and only the 'luogo' keys. Organizzatore can list/assign/edit/revoke. Assigning an email that already has a credential account (amm/col/superadmin) returns 409. Amministratore keeps PDF export. Disable blocks the Utente and the collaboratore. Reactivate gives the Utente only the still-active event, still no back-end; the collaboratore can log in again; roles in the DB are unchanged. Frontend: the event-users dialog, assign form, Utente edit, revoked row, Collaboratori dialog, /accesso-evento (masked email, 'Invia il codice', invalid-token error), /miei-eventi with 'Il tuo incarico', and the redirects from /app, /eventi, /staff-volontari, /piattaforma to /miei-eventi all work. The Super Admin users list shows Tipologia 'Utente (link evento)'/'Collaboratore'/'Gestionale', and 'Gestisci accessi' shows the access-event-user block. Organizzatore/Amministratore labels appear in Utenti e Permessi. One layout bug in the event-users dialog was fixed: the name/email column collapsed so the text wrapped one character per line.

minor.issue: Uses only get_current_user and checks that the file's org_id matches the user's org_id. An event_user has org_id set, so with a known file_id it can download any file of its org. This is a back-end data leak for UTENTE (low risk because the id must be known). Block role event_user here.

No explicit block for event_user. No org data leaked in my tests, but a global deny for role=='event_user' (for example in get_current_user, with an allowlist of /auth/me, /auth/logout, /my-event-access) would be fail-closed and stop future leaks.
A collaboratore whose membership has no explicit permissions can list event Utenti (200), including their emails. Assigning still returns 403. Check that this is intended.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: the name/email column collapsed to about 10px, so the email and incarico wrapped one character per line. Status and link info moved into the left column; the buttons are now shrink-0.

issues: The RUOLO field shows the raw global role 'Admin' (user.role, capitalized). For the Organizzatore it should show 'Organizzatore'/'Amministratore' to match the new labels.
EventUserOnly redirects to /login, but a Utente has no password. It should show a message such as 'riapri il link ricevuto via email'.
Shows in English (EN selected) on the Italian pages /accesso-evento and /miei-eventi (pre-existing).

action_items: Block event_user on GET /api/files/{file_id}. Better: deny event_user in get_current_user except an allowlist (/auth/me, /auth/logout, /my-event-access).
Show the membership role label (Organizzatore/Amministratore/Collaboratore) on /profilo instead of the raw user.role 'Admin'.
For a logged-out Utente on /miei-eventi, show a 'riapri il link' message instead of redirecting to /login.
Confirm whether a collaboratore should see GET /event-users (list with emails).
critical_code_review_comments: event_users.py: verify() reads the latest unused code and blocks at 5 attempts. send_code allows 5 codes per hour, so a brute-force attempt is capped at about 25 guesses per hour per link, which is acceptable.

event_users.py: _send_link marks the user's earlier active links 'replaced', so resending (or assigning a second event) invalidates the previous email link. This is expected but should be documented in the UI.
event_users.py list_assign: the (us.get(a['user_id']) or {}) lookup is repeated 5 times; minor DRY issue.
Disabling an account deletes its user_sessions, and get_current_user also checks active, so blocking takes effect immediately. Verified.
seed_data_creation: Utente sessions came from links and codes inserted straight into the DB (ids TEST_l_*, TEST_c_*, TEST_lui_*, TEST_cui_*), all deleted afterwards. One temporary Utente, test_eu_new_<hex>@example.com, was assigned through the API (1 real email sent to example.com) and then deleted. user_sessions rows for user_df941f23995e created by verify are left for the main agent's cleanup. The Super Admin disable/reactivate of test_eu_user and test_eu_col was restored to active.
